mentions.name: Doomberg Terminal
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that uses VSCode's core libraries exactly as they are used in an Electron app to drive VSCode and Cursor, relying on VSCode's IPC/RPC to let all execution contexts and remote runtimes communicate with each other; this approach addressed problems the author had automating browsers with a Chrome extension.
